prompt: We want to lock down the exact JSON shape of error responses so future refactors don't silently change the API. Add a regression test that pins the envelope body for a representative error.

checklist.test-golden-files: A golden file (e.g. test/fixtures/<name>.golden.json) holds the expected envelope body and the test compares against it, consistent with the existing test/fixtures/envelope.golden.json pattern.
checklist.test-assert-observable: The comparison is done on the observable response shape (e.g. assert.deepStrictEqual), not on internal state of toEnvelope().
